legend: Zhong Ziqian got an integer array a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$ and an integer x$$$x$$$ as birthday presents.

Every day after that, he tried to find a non-empty subsequence of this array 1≤b1<b2<…<bk≤n$$$1 \leq b_1  \lt  b_2  \lt  \ldots  \lt  b_k \leq n$$$, such that for all pairs (i,j)$$$(i, j)$$$ where 1≤i<j≤k$$$1 \leq i  \lt  j \leq k$$$, the inequality abi⊕abj≥x$$$a_{b_i} \oplus a_{b_j} \geq x$$$ held. Here, ⊕$$$\oplus$$$ is the bitwise exclusive-or operation.
Of course, every day he must find a different subsequence.
How many days can he do this without repeating himself? As this number may be very large, output it modulo 998244353$$$998\,244\,353$$$.
input: The first line of the input contains two integers n$$$n$$$ and x$$$x$$$ (1≤n≤300000$$$1 \leq n \leq 300\,000$$$, 0≤x≤260−1$$$0 \leq x \leq 2^{60}-1$$$). Here, n$$$n$$$ is the size of the array.
The next line contains n$$$n$$$ integers a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$: the array itself (0≤ai≤260−1$$$0 \leq a_i \leq 2^{60}-1$$$).
output: Output one integer: the number of subsequences of Ziqian's array such that bitwise xor of every pair of elements is at least x$$$x$$$, modulo 998244353$$$998\,244\,353$$$.
note: In the first example, all 23−1$$$2^3-1$$$ non-empty subsequences are suitable.

in the second example, two non-empty subsequences are not suitable, it is b=[1,2]$$$b = [1, 2]$$$ and b=[1,2,3]$$$b = [1, 2, 3]$$$, that is because a1⊕a2=0⊕1=1$$$a_1 \oplus a_2 = 0 \oplus 1 = 1$$$ which is smaller than 2$$$2$$$.
In the third example, b=[1],b=[2],b=[3],b=[2,3]$$$b = [1], b = [2], b = [3], b = [2, 3]$$$ are suitable.

legend.ai: Zhong Ziqian 收到了一个整数数组 a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$ 和一个整数 x$$$x$$$ 作为生日礼物。

在那之后的每一天，他都试图找到这个数组的一个非空子序列 1≤b1<b2<…<bk≤n$$$1 \leq b_1  \lt  b_2  \lt  \ldots  \lt  b_k \leq n$$$，使得对于所有满足 1≤i<j≤k$$$1 \leq i  \lt  j \leq k$$$ 的数对 (i,j)$$$(i, j)$$$，不等式 abi⊕abj≥x$$$a_{b_i} \oplus a_{b_j} \geq x$$$ 都成立。这里，⊕$$$\oplus$$$ 是按位异或运算。
当然，他每天必须找到一个不同的子序列。
他能在不重复自己的情况下这样做多少天？由于这个数可能非常大，请输出它模 998244353$$$998\,244\,353$$$ 的结果。

input.ai: 下一行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 a1,a2,…,an$$$a_1, a_2, \ldots, a_n$$$：即数组本身(0≤ai≤260−1$$$0 \leq a_i \leq 2^{60}-1$$$)。

output.ai: 输出一个整数：Ziqian 的数组的子序列个数，使得每一对元素的按位异或都至少为 x$$$x$$$，对 998244353$$$998\,244\,353$$$ 取模。

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，所有 23−1$$$2^3-1$$$ 个非空子序列都是合适的。
